turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going back to work after staying home with my kids for five years. How do I explain the gap?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Be direct and positive. Say you took time to raise your children and you're excited to get back to work.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The neighbours complained about my trumpet practice. Again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ouch. Trumpets are loud. Would you try a practice mute at home, or rent a practice room a couple of times a week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Excuse me for a moment, my friend has a question. Don't talk until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So if I get this job, would you actually be okay moving up north?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Honestly? I've been thinking about it all week.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'd miss my sister. But my work is remote anyway, so it's not like I'd lose anything there.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We could come back every month or so.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Every month is a lot of driving. Let's see if you even get an offer before we start packing boxes.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fair. You're right, one step at a time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, back. Thanks for being patient.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, are you going quiet at home, or practising elsewhere?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Won't they think my skills are out of date?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Show them otherwise. Mention any courses, volunteering or projects you did, even small ones.
